msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia merceria-mari-carmen-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of soft balls of merino and mohair yarn in many colours with a wooden crochet hook from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-mari-carmen-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a ball of rust orange merino wool yarn, no label from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of three gradient yarn cakes in rainbow tones from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-mari-carmen-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a red crochet triangle shawl with a long grey fringe on a hanger from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a set of bamboo crochet hooks of different sizes in a floral fabric case from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
